messages:
Maya (CS): quick flag — onboarding calls with CuraLife surfaced the same 3 asks across 3 teams. think this could be a renewal risk if we don't show movement. tagging @Aisha @Devon

Aisha (Product): thanks Maya. can you paste the asks and any customer language? rough priority is fine for now.

Maya (CS): sure. pasted below + attached export to the support ticket. TL;DR: visibility into cost per route/environment, tighter rollout controls for PHI-sensitive endpoints, and mobile streaming/session stability on flaky networks.

Maya (CS): 1) Console: per-route & per-environment cost breakdown (today exports only). impact: finance + procurement need line-items to justify spend. multiple customers requested.

Maya (CS): 2) Deployment scoping / pinning: let orgs limit which model variants can be used per team/endpoint (so security teams can block unvetted variants for PHI). impact: compliance + legal signoff on sensitive workloads.

Maya (CS): 3) Mobile SDK: improve session persistence & reconnect logic (streams time out or re-init poorly on cellular handoff). impact: demos fail and devs file bugs.

Devon (PM): my read: 3 is high-impact engineering work (could be a quick reliability ticket), 1 is a UX + billing backend workstream (medium), 2 is bigger (RBAC + audit trail + legal).

Leo (CS): I can collect sample invoices and one-sentence quotes from each team at CuraLife this week. do you want customer-facing language or internal tags?

Aisha (Product): internal tags first (billing_visibility, rollout_control, sdk_connectivity). if we put on roadmap we'll ask for a one-paragraph customer brief + exact renewal impact.

Sarah (AE): renewal for CuraLife is 2025-03-10. they mentioned procurement wants per-route cost before signing. flagging budget sensitivity.

Maya (CS): adding short CSV snippet I pulled from the onboarding export for context:

Maya (CS): ```
customer,ask,impact,quote
CuraLife,per_route_cost,finance needs line items,"Procurement can't sign off without per-route breakdown"
CuraLife,variant_pinning,security must limit variants,"We need to prevent unvetted models on PHI endpoints"
CuraLife,sdk_reconnect,mobile demos unreliable,"On LTE handoffs the stream drops and the app loses context"
```

feedback-bot: summary created and tagged [billing_visibility, rollout_control, sdk_connectivity]. linked issue PROD-Triage-671.

Devon (PM): I'll open PROD-Triage-671 and propose priorities: sdk_connectivity -> P1, per_route_cost -> P2, variant_pinning -> P3. will add initial engineering estimate for 3 next sprint.

Aisha (Product): please add to next roadmap sync. I want the CuraLife quotes before we commit any timeline.

Leo (CS): got it — will drop quotes and invoice sample into the ticket and add a one-paragraph customer brief by Mon.

Maya (CS): action items: Maya collect quotes + invoice CSV; Leo prepare customer brief + add to roadmap; Devon open umbrella ticket and assign; Aisha to review for legal/security. :thumbsup:

Sarah (AE): I'll prep an internal renewal note and flag to CSM if Product moves this forward.

Maya (CS): looping in later this week with the customer snippets. :eyes:
